author: Leon Made This / s010s

description.en: A. louisae CM3018-inspired whole-living supporting prop. Cervical interpolation and soft tissue are interpretive; limb roots use disclosed internal overlaps. Original QA front/rear images retain clipping advisories; website images are separate presentation, not repaired QA evidence. Pose, colors and nominal authored dimensions are artistic. Independently reviewed at environment-prop scale; not museum precision, hero, rigged or animated anatomy.
description.zh: 迷惑龙：化石研究启发的完整活体风格化环境配角；姿态、颜色、软组织与名义尺寸含艺术解释，并非精确单一标本、博物馆级、主角、绑定或动画复原。原独审正后视图裁切仍为NOT_PASS，补览不替换原证据；网站图仅为展示。
